subject: Emotions
title: Attachment Styles and EQ
description: A short lesson to help you apply Attachment Styles and EQ.

hook.text: She texts him. He doesn't reply for hours. She spirals into anxiety. He feels smothered. Same event, different wiring.

buildup.text: John Bowlby and Mary Ainsworth identified attachment styles: secure, anxious, avoidant, and disorganized.

discovery.text: Secure attachment means comfort with closeness and independence. Only about 50% of adults are securely attached.

twist.text: Anxious-avoidant pairs attract magnetically. The pursuer-distancer dance feels exciting but creates chronic pain.

climax.text: Attachment styles can change through therapy or a consistently secure partner. The brain rewires with safe experience.

punchline.text: Your attachment style isn't your destiny. It's your starting point.

quiz.question: What percentage of adults are securely attached?
